environment.description: Docker container running Ubuntu 22.04 with texlive-full installed. Container runs as root with default Docker seccomp profile. pdflatex is invoked with -shell-escape flag. Network egress is unrestricted. Container has CAP_SYS_ADMIN capability for FUSE mounts used by the PDF preview system. No AppArmor profile loaded (--security-opt apparmor=unconfined).
